thesis: The guest explains that his interest in investing began as a hobby in the late 1990s during the tech bubble and deepened after leaving the military and attending grad school, where he started trading aggressively and found the activity more engaging than physics. He notes that his background in physics and philosophy, specifically a shared interest in the philosopher Chopin, connects him to the host, and he describes his analytical approach as one that leaves no stone unturned to reach the base level of everything.
